description: Stand up an OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint on a rented or owned GPU box: pick the instance, fetch and quantize weights, serve with SGLang — speculative decoding, prefix caching and tool calling for agent workloads — then verify it and expose the port. Carries the CUDA/JIT traps that cost hours the first time (CCCL header checks, MAX_JOBS OOM, flashinfer cubin version skew, NVFP4 checkpoints, mamba state cache).
description_zh: 在租用或自有的 GPU 机器上部署 OpenAI 兼容的模型服务：选实例、拉权重与量化、用 SGLang 开投机解码/前缀缓存/tool calling 服务 agent 负载，再验证并开放端口。附带第一次部署会耗掉数小时的 CUDA/JIT 坑（CCCL 头文件校验、MAX_JOBS 内存打爆、flashinfer cubin 版本错位、NVFP4 checkpoint、mamba 状态缓存）。
short_description: Self-host an LLM endpoint on a GPU box with SGLang.
short_description_zh: 在 GPU 机器上用 SGLang 自部署模型接口。
